parts.text: Process died — nohup didn't survive. Restart detached with setsid or disown, keep alive. Use nohup + disown in a way that persists. The bash tool uses persistent shell session; maybe process killed. Try launching again and verify it stays. Use `setsid` not on macOS by default... macOS: use `nohup ... &` should work but shell may kill children. Better: launch via `launchctl`? Simpler: run with `disown`.
Process died. Relaunching detached so it stays:

input.command: (setsid bun run dev > /tmp/portfolio-dev.log 2>&1 < /dev/null &) ; sleep 4; ps aux | rtk grep "next dev" | rtk grep -v grep | head -2; rtk curl -s -o /dev/null -w "HTTP %{http_code}" http://localhost:3000

parts.text: setsid missing on macOS. Use launchctl to keep it alive permanently — "keep it running always" suggests a persistent service. Use launchd with KeepAlive. Create a LaunchAgent plist.
macOS lacks `setsid`. Using launchd instead so it stays up always and auto-restarts if it crashes:

input.command:
mkdir -p ~/Library/LaunchAgents && cat > ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.dhruv.portfolio-dev.plist <<'EOF'
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE plist PUBLIC "-//Apple//DTD PLIST 1.0//EN" "http://www.apple.com/DTDs/PropertyList-1.0.dtd">
<plist version="1.0">
<dict>
  <key>Label</key><string>com.dhruv.portfolio-dev</string>
  <key>WorkingDirectory</key><string>/Users/dhruv2mars/dev/github/portfolio</string>
  <key>ProgramArguments</key>
  <array>
    <string>/Users/dhruv2mars/.bun/bin/bun</string>
    <string>run</string>
    <string>dev</string>
  </array>
  <key>RunAtLoad</key><true/>
  <key>KeepAlive</key><true/>
  <key>StandardOutPath</key><string>/tmp/portfolio-dev.log</string>
  <key>StandardErrorPath</key><string>/tmp/portfolio-dev.log</string>
</dict>
</plist>
EOF
launchctl unload ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.dhruv.portfolio-dev.plist 2>/dev/null; launchctl load ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.dhruv.portfolio-dev.plist && sleep 5 && rtk curl -s -o /dev/null -w "HTTP %{http_code}" http://localhost:3000

Index: lib/site.ts
===================================================================
--- lib/site.ts	
+++ lib/site.ts	
@@ -1,58 +1,62 @@
 export type SocialLink = {
   label: "X" | "GitHub" | "LinkedIn" | "Email";
   href: string;
 };
 
 export const site = {
   name: "Dhruv Sharma",
   handle: "Dhruv2mars",
   /** The role, shown under the name. Lowercase on purpose. */
   tagline: "agentic engineer",
   /**
    * The role line said more than one way. The first is the canonical one — it
    * is what `tagline` carries into metadata and structured data, where nothing
    * can rotate — and the rest widen it without the hero growing a paragraph.
    */
   flipSentences: [
     "agentic engineer",
     "prototyper",
     "tooling for coding agents",
   ] as const,
   /**
    * How the name sounds. `audio` is the answer — a recording of the name being
    * said — and `phonetic` is the same answer written down, shown on the button
    * for anyone who would rather read it. With no recording the button is not
    * drawn: a synthesised English voice has neither the breathy d nor the
    * retroflex v, so it says a different name confidently, which is worse than
    * silence.
    */
   pronunciation: {
     phonetic: "/dʱruːʋ ˈʃərmə/",
     audio: "/audio/dhruv-sharma.mp3" as string | null,
   },
   /**
    * The one-line description search results, feed readers and the install
    * manifest read. It is not rendered on the page: the hero already says the
    * name and the role, and a third line under them was prose the page did not
    * need. See `app/layout.tsx`.
    */
   description:
     "I build tooling for coding agents — repro harnesses, queues, local-first inference — and ship with them every day.",
   url: "https://dhruv2mars.com",
-  /** High-resolution source frame for the current Codex pet. */
-  avatar: "/avatar/sunny.png" as string | null,
+  /**
+   * No portrait exists yet. The profile header reserves this slot and renders
+   * a monogram at the same size; setting this to an image path is the only

   ] as const satisfies readonly SocialLink[],

 } as const;

     .filter((s) => !s.href.startsWith("mailto:"))
     .map((s) => s.href);
 }
